Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this match. There is a rest day in the ICC Women's World Cup 2022 on Wednesday. The action will resume on Thursday, 24th March 2022, and we will have another set of two games coming your way - South Africa Women vs West Indies Women at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day) and England Women vs Pakistan Women at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). Both matches hold great importance for England and West Indies, in particular. You can join us in advance for the build-up. Meanwhile, Bangladesh Women are chasing a target of 230 against India Women in the second game of the day. You can switch tabs and enjoy all the updates. Cheers!

Meg Lanning, the winning captain of Australia Women, starts by saying that 271 was par as it was a fantastic pitch with the ball coming on nicely and they felt they were in the game. Mentions that it was a fresh wicket and they thought with the sun out, it will only get better to bat on and that's what happened. Tells that they didn't get the early wickets but they held their nerves very well with the ball. Regarding the fitness of Ellyse Perry, Meg replies that she doesn't have the exact update but Perry would have come to bat if it was needed. States that they brought the required rate down and that allowed them a breathing space. Admits that they played a few loose shots and got away with it. Feels that there are still things to work on and hopes to be on the money against Bangladesh Women.

Sune Luus, the skipper of South Africa Women, says that they had a great first inning and she thought 271 will be par on this surface but Meg Lanning played a fantastic knock. Adds that on another day, their bowling attack would have defended that. On her form, Sune replies that it's nice to contribute with the bat and set the big totals. Admits that they lost focus in the field and hopes it won't happen again. She calls Shabnim Ismail's effort phenomenal. Luus wants more consistency from her spinners. Mentions that they have one day to prepare for West Indies Women and is aware that they have not yet nailed their spot in the semis.

Meg Lanning (135*) is the Player of the Match! She says that it was nice to contribute and bat through. Tells that it was her turn today and it would be someone else next time. Admits that it was a bit tricky at the start but then she got the momentum after seeing off that phase. Praises Shabnim Ismail for her spell. Regarding her form, Lanning replies that she was disappointed with her show at the start of the tournament as she was not clinical. Lauds the efforts of Beth Mooney and Tahlia McGrath and shares that her plan was to hold one end and bat the distance.

South Africa Women would like to delete this performance from their system. The batting unit did a decent job but when you face a team like Australia Women, your 'decent' is not going to be enough. A total in excess of 300 could have pushed the Aussies but South Africa Women were not allowed to breach that mark. Apart from the last 4 overs, the Aussie bowlers, despite not picking many wickets, managed to put a lid on the scoring rate. South Africa Women didn't do the same with the ball, especially in the middle overs and their abysmal ground fielding along with poor catching piled on the misery even more. Stay tuned for the presentation...

In pursuit, Australia Women lost both their openers fairly early and were in a spot of bother. But Meg Lanning showed her class after that and played a fine knock. She combined for a 60-run stand with Beth Mooney and steadied the chase. Her knock was quite fluent and kept the runs flowing. That didn't allow South Africa Women to build much pressure through the middle overs. With Tahlia McGrath, Lanning formed a 93-run alliance and that nearly sealed the game for them. The asking rate never troubled them and Lanning made sure to bat the distance to see Australia Women home.

Annihilation. Decimation. Domination. Two unbeaten teams clashed and Australia Women showed who is the real boss! South Africa Women have got completely outclassed. Powered by the knock of Laura Wolvaardt, it was quite a challenging total on the board but the Aussies ended up making a mockery of it. They have hit a sixer in this edition, beating six teams and now only Bangladesh Women are left to be conquered.
Winning runs! Full and way down the leg side. Sutherland helps it away to fine leg for a single. Australia Women continue their unbeaten streak in this edition as they win by 5 wickets.
Full, sliding on middle. Sutherland pushes it to mid on.
Darted on the pads, it is tucked to deep square leg for a single. Scores level!
Floated, on off, Lanning works it to sweeper cover for one more.
Tossed up, outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Very full and outside off. Sutherland fails to guide it down to third man.
SIX! Dispatched! 4 runs away now! A freebie, full toss around waist height. Sutherland dances down the track and clubs it well over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slightly short and on off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single. Just 10 runs are needed now.
A length ball, on middle. Sutherland is early into her shot as she chips it in the air but the ball falls well short of mid on.
Fuller and on off, it is pushed to mid off.
Full and slanting around leg. Sutherland whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and on the pads, Meg Lanning helps it to mid-wicket and collects a quick single.

Dropped! Add another to the list! Full ball, angling on middle, Lanning pushes it straight back to Khaka who dives low to her right but spills it out. Tough but at this level, this should have been taken.
Shorter and outside off. Lanning cuts it to point. The fielder half-stops and a single is taken.
Full again, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Very full and on off. Annabel keeps it out.
Flatter and on middle, it is played to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Another misfield! Short and around off. Sutherland waits and punches it to extra cover. A misfield in the inner circle and it will always prove costly. A boundary.
Angling on the pads. Sutherland fails to hit on the leg side.
Full and on middle, Sutherland clips it to mid-wicket for a single as the fielder fumbles there.
FOUR! A fuller ball, on off. Sutherland steps forward and smashes it past the bowler, to the right of mid off and it goes to the fence.
Touch fuller and on off. Blocked out on the off side.
Length ball, angling around off. Sutherland is cramped for room as she punches it to covers.
A length ball, outside off. Sutherland punches it to point where the fielder dives to her right to stop it.
Full and around off. Lanning gets low to sweep it to deep mid-wicket. One run.
Tossed up, on off. Lanning goes back in her crease and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Ayabonga Khaka is back on.
Full again, Lanning works it to mid off.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
A full toss, on middle. Lanning comes down the track and mistimes her heave over Lee at mid on. They cross for a couple of runs.
Floated, full and on off. Another solid defense as Lanning prods.
Tossed up, angling on middle. Lanning defends this out.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 25-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Loopy and full around off, Annabel drives it down to mid off. 29 needed more.
A half-tracker outside off, punched from the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Skidding down the leg side, it's helped through square leg for a single.
Very full and on middle, it's knocked down the ground but straight to mid on.
Ellyse Perry is now eligible to bat but it's Annabel Sutherland who comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tumi Sekhukhune shows how it's taken.  Chloe Tryon delivers it short and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner goes back to punch it through the line but it takes the toe end and flies to mid off. Tumi Sekhukhune is stationed inside the ring and she jumps to complete the catch. 31 needed off 64 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Tumi Sekhukhune b Chloe Tryon

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off, slapped off the back foot to covers.
Lands it full and outside off, Meg Lanning strokes it through covers and collects two.
Fullish and outside off, chipped over covers for one.
Full and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner winds up for a big shot but connects only with thin air.
Fuller and around off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Easy pickings with no protection in the deep. A touch too full, around off, Ashleigh Gardner leans into the shot and lofts it over cover-point for a boundary.
Hurls across a length ball, around off, Ashleigh Gardner punches it to covers.
Delivers it on a good length outside off, going straight on, Lanning pushes inside the line and misses.
Serves it on a length around off, Meg pushes it with an angled bat to point.
A touch short in length, around leg, it's glanced behind square leg for one.
Spears in a full ball on middle, Ashleigh Gardner presents a straight bat as she tries to push it down but misses and is pinged high on the front leg.
On a length, around middle, the batter works it behind square leg for a single.

Sliding down the leg side, Meg Lanning fails to get any bat behind it. It clips her thigh pad and goes behind to the keeper. The replays show that there was an inside edge but Trisha Chetty has not collected the ball. Another dropped catch, then.
A low full toss on off, it's driven to sweeper cover for a single. 40 needed more.
Uses the angle of the bowler and helps it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Spanked! Width there outside off, Ashleigh Gardner latches onto it and whacks it past backward point for a boundary.
On a length and angling in around middle, Ashleigh Gardner pushes it down to mid on.
Fuller in length and around off, Meg Lanning strokes it to sweeper cover and picks up three runs.
Fuller and on off, Gardner drives it to covers where the fielder lets it through and they get a couple.
On a length and outside off, just inside the tram line, Ashleigh Gardner throws her bat at it but fails to connect.
Pitches it up and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner drives but finds point.
On middle, fuller, played back to the bowler.
Length again, on middle. Gardner mistimes her flick and it takes the leading edge, drops in front of the bowler.
A length ball, outside off. Gardner misses her cut.

DROPPED AND FOUR! The wheels are coming off for South Africa Women. This is an abysmal display of ground fielding and catching. Fuller in length, around middle and leg, Meg Lanning shovels it across the line and hits it aerially to deep mid-wicket. Lara Goodall fails to catch it over her head and spills a simple catch. It goes behind and finds the fence as well.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner slices her drive to third man for a run.
Width there again outside off, Lanning slaps it to third man for one.
Full and angling in around leg, it's lifted over mid on for a couple.
Width there outside off, smashed through the line but straight to point.
Tumi Sekhukhune is back on.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Short in length and outside off, feeding Meg Lanning in her favourite area. She has no qualms in blazing it through point. Mignon du Preez misfields near the fence and it goes for a boundary.
Slower delivery, on a length and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner flashes her bat at it but misses.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length, around off, Gardner goes back to punch but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Full and around leg, angling down, Ashleigh Gardner tries to flick but misses. It goes off her pads to backward point.
Covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Wide! Slower one gone wrong. It's down the leg side.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.

What happened there? A shout for a caught behind is made. Not given and South Africa Women have decided to take the DRS. Nothing on the UltraEdge. Coming to the delivery, it's sliding down the leg side, Meg Lanning goes down to sweep but fails to connect properly. Trisha Chetty collects the ball and appeals. The finger stays down. There is no bat. The wide is signalled now!
EDGY FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Ashleigh Gardner once again throws her bat at it and edges it wide of first slip for a boundary.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Lizelle Lee is the culprit again, she had dropped one catch earlier also. A touch short and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner tries to force it off the back foot but gets a thick outside edge. Lizelle Lee dives across to her right but it bursts through her hands and goes behind for a boundary.
Ashleigh Gardner is the batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket against the run of play. South Africa Women are not celebrating much. They realize that the game has slipped away after this 93-run stand. It's a soft dismissal. Short in length and on middle, Tahlia McGrath mistimes her pull shot from the splice of her bat. It lobs to mid-wicket and Marizanne Kapp takes an easy catch. 74 needed more off 104 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Marizanne Kapp b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Short and on middle, pulled behind square leg for a run.
Skidding off the surface. Full and outside off, Meg Lanning is beaten for pace as he fails to connect with her attempted cover drive.
Beaten! Short and outside off, Meg tries to use the pace and run it down to third man but misses.
Pace off this time, short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath picks it but only manages to cut it towards point. 75 needed more off 108 balls.
Fuller and on off, Tahlia McGrath uses the angle and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends.
SIX! Smashed! The one-way traffic continues. Full and around off, in the slot for the batter, Tahlia McGrath flexes her muscles and dismisses it behind the bowler for a maximum.
Fullish and around off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.

Dropped! Short in length and outside off, Tahlia McGrath plays a half-hearted flat-batted shot and it goes aerially to Lizelle Lee at short third man who shells it over her head. They cross for a single.
Connects with her square cut this time and gets a single as the fielder at deep point collects it.
Another play and a miss! Shabnim Ismail keeps it short and wide outside off, Lanning tries to cut but it bounces over her bat.
Short in length and outside off, Meg Lanning tries to cut but misses.

A concussion protocol is going on as Meg Lanning gets hit on the helmet. She looks fine. The players take the time to take a quick drink as well. Right now, it looks like Australia Women's game as only 85 runs are needed. South Africa Women need a flurry of wickets to get back into the game.

FOUR LEG BYES! This has happened for the second time in this match. Short in length, around middle, Meg Lanning tries to pull but misses. It brushes her helmet and flies behind the keeper for a boundary. In the first innings, Laura Wolvaardt took a blow on her helmet while batting and had fetched four leg byes.
Starts with a length ball, around off, Meg defends it from the crease.
Shabnim Ismail is back on.
A length ball, outside off. McGrath cuts it but finds point. 89 needed in 120 balls.
Overpitched, outside off. McGrath drives it wide of deep cover for a brace now.
Length ball, outside off. McGrath shuffles inside her crease and looks to cut but misses.
Outside off. Lanning cuts it late and to third man for a single.
Length and outside off, Lanning cuts it to point.

FOUR! CENTURY! Meg Lanning brings up her 15th ODI century and 10 have come while chasing! She has made this chase look so easy. A true captain's knock and she continues her fine form in this tournament. A full toss, on middle, Meg Lanning shuffles and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. She was bitterly disappointed after getting out in the 90s against India Women and this knock will take away that disappointment.
Ayabonga Khaka is back for another spell. 0 for 20 in her 4 overs so far.
Very full and on off, pushed to covers. That means Lanning on 99 will be on the strike.
On a driving-length, outside off. McGrath looks to drive but misses.
Length and angling on off. McGrath dead-bats it to covers.
FOUR! Superb shot! Pitches it up, on off. McGrath leans and caresses it through covers for a boundary. No chance for the fielder in the deep. Under 100 needed now!
On middle, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Lanning drives it hard to point and a misfield by Laura Wolvaardt inside the ring helps the batters take a couple of runs.
Outside off, cut away to deep backward point for a single.
Length and on middle. McGrath flicks it in front of square for a single.
On the pads, this is pushed to long on for a single.
Slants a full ball, on middle, pushed back to Kapp.
Length ball, outside off. McGrath plays a late-cut to third man for a run.
Good fielding from the fielder at point as this full ball is pushed towards her. The batters still take a single.
Fullish and outside off. Meg drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side. Lanning misses her pull. Another extra from the South African bowlers.
Length ball, outside off. McGrath works it to point and jogs across for one more.
Very full and outside off. McGrath prods and drives it to the right of deep cover and two runs are taken with ease.
Short of a length, outside off. Lanning opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for one.
Angles it on middle, it is clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on off. Lanning plays it to covers for a single.
Full and outside off. McGrath drives it through covers and the batters take a couple of runs. The 50-run stand is up!
Tumi Sekhukhune is back on. 2-0-25-0 are her figures so far.
Wide! Length ball, way down the leg side. Tahlia misses her pull. A wide called.
Length and on off. Meg dabs it to point for a single.
FOUR! Lanning moves to 89. Short of a length, on middle. Lanning bends back and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Angles a full ball, on middle. Defended out.
Leg bye! Length ball, sliding down the leg side. McGrath misses her flick. It goes off the pads to square leg for a leg bye.
Short in length and on middle, Lanning hooks it to deep square leg for a single.
Marizanne Kapp (4-0-20-0) is back on.
Tossed up, on off. McGrath steers it to short third man.
Floated and on off, McGrath sweeps it to fine leg and the fielder there runs across to stop it. A couple of runs added to the scoreboard.
Very full and on off. McGrath comes down the track and tries to smash it but mistimes it back to the bowler. Luus tries to deflect it on the stumps at the non-striker's end but Lanning is safely in.
Shorter and outside off, cut away to deep extra cover for a single.
A flighted full toss, on middle. Lanning gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and on off, it is drilled down to long off for a single.
Short ball, slower and outside off. Lanning again cuts it but this time short third man collects it on a bounce.
Tossed up, on middle. McGrath wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A single as this is hit to deep covers.
FOUR! The Meg Lanning pet shot! Short again, outside off. Lanning cuts it, past the diving point and the short third man fielder can only see the ball racing away to the fence.
Tossed up, on off. Meg knocks it down to mid off.
FOUR! This is short and outside off. Lanning cuts it hard and finds the gap at extra cover for a boundary. Once it beat the in-ring fielder, it was always a boundary.
Very full and on off, pushed to point.

Dropped! The skipper herself puts it down! A full toss and on middle. McGrath tries to go over the bowler but hits off the toe end of the bat. Sune Luus jumps and gets her right hand in the air but fails to hold onto it.
Around off, McGrath dabs it to point.
Slightly short and on middle. Lanning picks it up and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Given air this time, on middle, Lanning skips down and pushes it straight to covers.
A flighted ball, full and on middle. Lanning paddles it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Floated, on middle, Meg works it through covers for a single. 145 runs needed in 168 balls.
This is good batting, just playing around the corner and keeping the scoreboard ticking. On the pads. Lanning waits and helps it to fine leg for two more.
Around off. Defended to covers.
A slower ball, angling on the pads. Lanning gets inside her crease and tickles it to fine leg for a brace.
Very full and on off. Lanning mistimes her push back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle, it is flicked in front of square leg for a single.
Luus still finding her rhythm. On middle, swept to deep square leg for one more.
Another full toss, on middle. Lanning sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Lanning turns it to deep mid-wicket and pushes hard to complete two runs. Good running.
A full toss, on middle. McGrath gets low and pulls it to deep square leg and they take a single. There was a fumble but they stick with just a run.
Full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Sune Luus is into the attack.
Full and way outside off. Tahlia McGrath drives it through covers for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Another sweet shot! Meg Lanning is batting like a dream. Chloe Tryon overcorrects her length and goes short around off, Meg goes back and punches it through covers for a boundary. Great timing and placement. 158 needed more off 30 overs.
FOUR! Wrong line and punished. Full and flighted, skidding down the leg side, Meg Lanning kneels down and sweeps it sweetly to the fine leg fence.
Flighted and on middle, defended back.
Short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath goes back and cuts it through point for a run - opens her account.
Tahlia McGrath walks out now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sekhukhune has proved to be very expensive with the ball but through her sharp fielding, she has broken the partnership which was looking dangerous. A flighted ball, full and around middle, Beth Mooney clips it off her pads to square leg and looks for a run. She is sent back and has to turn and run. But before that, Tumi Sekhukhune picks up the ball, has one stump to aim at and hits the bull's eye. The third umpire is referred but Mooney is not waiting. She knows her time is over!
Run out appeal! Beth Mooney is walking back without waiting for the decision. She knows, actually, the replay shows she is nowhere near her crease.
Taps a length ball down to covers for a single.
Fuller in length, outside off, Mooney drives it through point for a couple.
On the pads, turned behind square leg for a run.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR LANNING! It has come in quick time as well and once again she is leading from the front. This is buffet bowling from Tumi Sekhukhune - serving at both sides of the stumps. Down the leg side, Meg Lanning goes down on one knee and smacks it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Comes from 'round the wicket and delivers it short and outside off, Beth guides it down to third man for a run.
Wide! Another one served down the leg side, Mooney again failed to flick. Once more Trisha Chetty has not collected the ball but this time the batters don't run.

Three wides! Tumi Sekhukhune is struggling here. Sprays a length ball down the leg side, the batter fails to flick. Trisha Chetty also fails to collect and deflects it behind. Two taken by the batter.
Play and a miss! Angling away from the batter, on a length, Mooney throws her bat at it but fails to connect.
FOUR! Superb shot! Too full and around off, Beth Mooney strides forward and drives it crisply past the bowler. The mid off and mid on fielders are inside the ring and it's a boundary.
Loopy and full around off, defended.
Misses out, yet again. Another short ball outside off, Lanning fails to connect with her square cut.
Lucky, the bowler is lucky. Short and wide outside off, Meg cuts it straight to point.
Flatter again, full and around off, Lanning goes back and defends it down.
Short and outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Chloe Tryon is back into the attack. 1/15 in her first three overs.
Flighted and very full around off, Beth defends it to the off side.
Too full and around off, Lanning squeezes it out to point. 10 from Tumi Sekhukhune's first over.
Angling down the leg side, Mooney fails to work it around. It goes off her pads to short fine leg and they cross.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Another short ball, around middle, this time to the left-hander, Beth Mooney pulls it off the front foot and hammers it behind square leg.
Width there outside off, Meg runs it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! Can't bowl there to any batter, forget this batter. Short and on middle, Meg Lanning goes deep inside the crease and pulls it with authority to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Bowls it short and outside off, Lanning cuts from the back foot but finds point.

Drinks! Australia Women need 195 runs in 204 balls and Meg Lanning is playing a key role in this chase. She is batting at a brisk rate and at any moment, can take the game away. South Africa Women need to handle the middle phase just like how Australia did and also need to keep taking wickets at regular intervals. Tumi Sekhukhune is into the attack.
On a length and outside off, Beth Mooney offers no shot.
Fuller in length and outside off, Mooney drives it off the front foot to mid off.
Angling away from the batter outside off, Beth plays late and gently cuts it to point.
On a good length around off, defended down to gully.

FOUR! Up and just over the infield. Full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney walks forward and drives it aerially through the line. Mignon du Preez jumps inside the circle at covers but it goes over her and finds the fence.
Lands it on a length and gets it to shape back into the right-hander, Meg stays back and helps it towards the right side of mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Beth Mooney presses forward and pushes it to point.
Short and on middle, Meg Lanning steps back and punches it to the left of backward point. A single is taken. 200 needed now!
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, fuller in length, Meg tries to sweep but misses.
Fuller and on off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Bang! Don't bowl there to Meg Lanning! Short and wide outside off, Meg camps back and whacks it to the deep point fence.
Floated and full around off, Meg defends it off the front foot.
Short and around off, Beth goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
SIX! This one has been launched. Fuller in length around middle, a hint of inswing there, Meg Lanning finds it in her range and flicks it nonchalantly over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Serves it around off, Meg pushes it from the back foot to cover-point.
On a good length around off, defended.
Fuller and around off, shaping in, Meg Lanning defends it off the front foot.
Wide! Going down the leg side, Meg fails to flick.
Stays back and taps it down wide of point for a single.
Angling down the leg side, eased off the pads to fine leg for a run.
Flatter and around off, defended to the off side.
Loopy and full, around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and on off, Lanning cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flighted and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Floated and full around off, Beth works it to square leg for a single.
Edgy! Short in length, around off, Lanning tries to cut but gets an outside edge. The short third man fielder pulls it back and they get three runs.
Around middle and leg, it's nudged through square leg for a single.
On a good length around off, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it back.
Short in length and outside off, steered behind point for two.
Around middle and leg, again Meg fails to work it away on the leg side.
On a length around off, nipping in, Lanning tries to work it away but is cramped for room.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, on a good length, Meg tries to flick but misses.
Too full on this occasion, wide outside off, Mooney squeezes it out past backward point for two.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it gently to point.
Flighted and outside off, left alone.
Beth Mooney is the new batter.

OUT! THAT'S A STUNNER! Chloe Tryon buys a wicket with a rank long hop. It's the sheer brilliance of the fielder that has got this breakthrough for South Africa Women. Short in length and on middle, Rachael Haynes goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. There is not enough venom on the shot and the ball flies in the deep. Mignon du Preez is present there, she throws herself to her left and grabs it with both hands. That's defying gravity.
Commentary.Howout: c Mignon du Preez b Chloe Tryon

Commentary.Commentary: Full and flighted around off, it's driven through covers for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Meg cuts it to point. The fielder fumbles but no run is taken.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, there is another bowling change. Chloe Tryon replaces Shabnim Ismail from this end.
Length and around off, pushed to covers.
The length is dragged back, Haynes tries to punch again but hits it off the sticker on the blade to cover.
Touch fuller, outside off. Haynes punches it off the back foot through point and takes a couple of runs.
Length ball, slanting outside off. Haynes chops it to point.
Full, outside off. Left alone.
Starts with a length ball, angling outside off. Haynes tries to put pressure on her as she looks to go over covers but mistimes it. The fielder at covers does well to stop it.
Ayabonga Khaka is into the attack now. She has 10 wickets in this edition, the joint-most with Hayley Matthews, Marizanne Kapp and Lea Tahuhu.
Very full, on off. Lanning squeezes it out to mid off.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller ball, straight and on middle. Lanning whips it over mid-wicket for a powerful boundary.
Length and on off. Blocked to covers.
Length ball, on middle, Haynes is early as she flicks it. In the air but in the vacant square leg region and a single is taken.
FOUR! Australia getting boundaries at regular intervals! Fuller ball, outside off. Haynes strokes it past point, in the gap, for a boundary.
Short ball, on middle. Haynes sits under it.

Heavy roller was used during the break by Australia Women. Ian Smith was near the pitch during the innings break and he called the surface pristine. It got restored to the way it was at the start of the match due to the usage of the heavy roller. Very few footmarks Ian found and he felt that on this ground it's mainly about accumulating runs. He also informed that Basin Reserve has one of the quickest surfaces in the country with extra bounce. Shabnim Ismail to continue, she has found good assistance thus far...
Full, outside off and a bit of outward movement there. Lanning offers no shot.
FOUR! Drilled! A half-volley, outside off. Lanning smashes it through covers and the ball races away to the fence,
A length ball, around off, again this one jags back in. Lanning looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length ball, outside off, cut away but straight to point.
Fuller ball, on off, pushed to the left of mid off for a quick single.
A length ball, outside off. Lanning plays it late and with an angled bat, past the diving gully fielder for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Haynes slashes at it but misses. Lovely start from both the pacers. Keeping things tight.
A length ball, around off. Blocked out.
A length ball, around middle and off. Haynes tries to defend it very late but it takes the inside edge onto the pads. An appeal for LBW but there was clearly bat on it.
Outside off. Lanning dabs it to backward point. A fumble there and a single is taken.

FOUR! Edged and it races away to the fence! A length ball, angling around off. Lanning hops to defend but the ball nips away and takes the outside edge. The keeper, Trisha Chetty, is slightly wrong-footed and that makes the ball go past her right hand and wide of first slip for a boundary.
A length ball, on middle. Lanning with a solid defense.
Length ball, around off. Haynes is cramped up as she looks to cut. Ends up chopping it to point.
Edged! Fullish ball, slanting around off. Lanning goes for a big drive but gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies past second slip, to third man, for a single.
Length and on off. Defended on the surface.
FOUR! The width given to Lanning can always be dangerous! Length ball, way outside off. She cuts it with pure timing and gets it past point for a boundary.
Beaten! Kapp angles a length ball, just outside off, it lands and nips away. Lanning leans to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, outside off and shaping away. Lanning has nothing to do with it.
Angling in from around off, Rachael Haynes defends it from the inner portion of her bat. It rolls behind but stays away from the stumps. Maiden!
A short delivery, outside off, Rachael Haynes leaves.
Around middle, defended to mid-wicket.

A muted appeal for an lbw, the umpire stays unmoved. No thought was given to the use of the DRS. Shabnim Ismail fires it very full and around leg, Rachael Haynes tries to flick but perhaps misses to get hit on the pads. It can be two things - pitching outside leg or inside edge. Or maybe both.
Bouncer around leg, Rachael Haynes ducks underneath it. One for the over, signals the umpire.
Yorker around off, Rachael Haynes digs it out to cover-point.
Back of a length, around middle and leg, Haynes turns inside the crease and pulls it to long leg for a run.
Slightly short in length, around middle and leg, Meg shuffles across the stumps and turns it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off, Meg Lanning covers the line and lets it be.
Another delivery on a length and on top of off, Meg opens the face of her bat late but still finds the point fielder.
Angling in from a length around off, it's defended from the back foot.
Serves it on a length around off, Lanning stays back and pushes it to cover-point.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Lanning opens her account in an unconvincing manner. Fuller in length, around off and shaping away, Meg tries to defend but it takes the outside edge. Doesn't carry to first slip and gets deflected away by that fielder. The batters cross. End of an incredible over.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, Meg allows it through.
On a length outside off, skidding off the surface, Meg Lanning shoulders arms.
Fuller in length, around off, Meg defends it to the off side by keeping her bat close to the front pad.
Excellent delivery to greet the new batter. Puts it on a fuller length, close to off, Meg Lanning feels for it and gets beaten by the late away movement.
Meg Lanning walks out at number 3. She scored a match-winning 97 against India Women. Need another performance like that here.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! South Africa Women have struck early. Absolute beauty from Shabnim Ismail. She angles it in around off, on a full length and takes it away off the seam. Alyssa Healy gets on the front foot to push inside the line but only manages a thick outside edge. Trisha Chetty dives across to her right to complete the catch and the dangerous Healy departs cheaply.
Commentary.Howout: c Trisha Chetty b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length and outside off, Alyssa Healy looks to defend but it takes the inner edge and rolls down to deep backward square leg for a run. 7 from the over!
Slower one, on a length around middle, it's defended on the leg side.
FOUR Easy pickings! Drifting down the leg side, on a good length, Alyssa Healy gets enough bat behind it and sends it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Lands it full and around off, Healy drives it to covers.
Ellyse Perry, who bowled only three overs and was off the field for a majority of the first innings, can bat only after 110 minutes or at number seven, informs Nasser Hossain (on air).
Uses the angle of the bowler and works it to square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, pushed to covers.
Wide! Going down the leg side, the batter tries to flick but misses.
Who will start from the other end? It is Marizanne Kapp.
Serves a delivery on the fuller side, around off, Alyssa Healy defends it down to mid on.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven to the right of mid off for a single.
On a good length around middle and off, Haynes stays back and defends it to the off side.

FOUR! Fine shot! Shabnim Ismail perhaps wanted the follow-up delivery to be a yorker but it turns out to be a low full toss around off, Rachael Haynes strokes it through the gap between point and cover-point for a boundary.

Extra bounce there. Shabnim Ismail bowls it with a whippy action. Goes short and around off, Rachael Haynes is squared up in defense and it flies off the shoulder of the bat. Doesn't carry to backward point.
Begins with a delivery on the fuller side, around off, Rachael Haynes drills her drive through covers and collects a couple of runs.
